properties.p_3_meta_structure_position: Position #3 - Formal mediator enabling literal operation of cosmic dream code
properties.q_0_rests_on_repeated_acts: Pattern arises where operations have repeated — no structure without recurrence. Its ground is #2 done again and again until a shape shows through, and beneath that the void's standing offer of order.
properties.q_0_rests_on_vibration: M3's ground is Parashakti's vibrational template — Mahamaya stands where frequency must become symbol. From Anuttara's view it is M# (the World Dream principle); its thrown condition is the syntactic field of all possible interactions between particular and universal matrices, awaiting transcription into operational form.
properties.q_1_the_structure_itself: Pattern is the archetype of structure — the which, the logic, the repeatable shape. In the matheme it is 'I have knowledge of difference': the live act congealed into a thing one can hold, teach, store — knowledge as deposit rather than deed.
properties.q_1_universal_transcription_engine: M3 is the symbolic intelligence and universal transcription layer — the domain that turns vibrational templates into operational symbolic-biological reality. Its substance is the 64-bit alphabet with 8-fold rotational states, the triple-compass navigation, the 40 non-dual harmonic anchors: a living cosmic dream-code that generates genuinely new symbolic realities rather than mere correspondences.
properties.q_2_cross_domain_translation: M3 operates by transcription — quaternionic rotation enabling genuine translation across domains: DNA codons whispering through I-Ching hexagrams, proteins meditating as Major Arcana, harmonies dancing with archetypes. Its jazz-as-conversation dialogical capacity lets symbolic voices improvise together, generating not just meaning but new realities through shared vibrational architecture.
properties.q_2_operates_by_recognition: Pattern works by matching — 'which shape fits this?' It is the canonical scouring, the recognition that reads a new case against a held form. To pattern is to recognise; to recognise is to find the which already waiting.
properties.q_3_symbolic_pattern_code: M3's structure is the formal-symbolic itself — the Möbius ribosome topology expressing Paramasiva's spanda at the molecular level, the 64-bit codon-alphabet, the Euler-prime stability attractors. This is the which made symbol: the pattern-domain where #3's nominalised form becomes an operative code that adapts and responds while holding archetypal coherence and axio-logical integrity.
properties.q_3_the_nominalised_form: Pattern is the formal-structural position as such — the which, the logic that organises. It is Lacan's bar fallen: the live knowing become knowledge, signifier over signified (S/s), the deposit that never fully coincides with the act it came from. Structure as such — lawful, transmissible, and, left alone, in danger of forgetting it was ever a verb.
properties.q_4_for_the_sake_of_transmission: Pattern is for keeping — it lets a hard-won act be taught, repeated, carried across generations; the condition under which there is such a thing as inherited knowledge at all. Without the noun, nothing survives the one who knew it.
properties.q_4_parapara_bridge: M3 is for relation — the Parapara bridge generating the concept of Other through relational consciousness-grammar, the syntactic field where particular meets universal. Its why is translation across all disciplinary boundaries: a universal grammar where science and spirit, analysis and synthesis find coherent expression, ethics embedded within the symbolic relations themselves.
properties.q_5_adaptive_symbolic_synthesis: M3's synthesis is the operative symbolic organism — the adaptive code that responds to environment while maintaining archetypal coherence, handed forward to Nara's personal application. Mahamaya completes by becoming the symbolic language a life can be read in: its universal transcription sediments into the personal oracle M4 will cast.
properties.q_5_must_be_re_animated: Pattern integrates into Context (#4), but its synthesis carries a warning: the deposit can ossify. A pattern completes truly only when it is re-taken — the noun re-opened into its verb — the recovery #4 performs. Held but not re-animated, knowledge becomes dead data; #3 hands the live problem forward.

properties.c_1_description: Stagnation, obstruction, and lack of communication. Heaven above tends upward, Earth below tends downward - forces move apart. Communication blocked, energy doesn't flow. Time of discord where inferior elements gain influence. Wise person withdraws and preserves integrity.
c_1_line_texts: When ribbon grass is pulled up, the sod comes with it. Perseverance brings good fortune and success.
They bear and endure; this means good fortune for inferior people.
They bear shame.
He who acts at the command of the highest remains without blame.
Standstill is giving way. Good fortune for the great man.
The standstill comes to an end. First standstill, then good fortune.
properties.c_3_directional_power: Northwest authority divorced from Southwest receptivity - Command lacking supportive foundation and nurturing connection.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Separation breeds stagnation - Heaven's ascending force pulls away from Earth's descending nature, creating the unnatural divorce of cosmic principles. Communication fails as yin and yang retreat to their separate realms, leaving a sterile gap where creative intercourse should flow. Like lovers turning away from each other, this dynamic generates the cosmic standstill where nothing new can be born until reunion becomes possible.
properties.c_3_judgment: Standstill. Evil people do not further the perseverance of the superior man. The great departs; the small approaches.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Lake over Thunder nuclear shows that standstill contains proper following - separation teaches value of right relationship.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Abdomen/Spleen separated from Head/Lungs - Digestive foundation pulling away from respiratory authority, where natural energies move in opposite directions creating dangerous psychosomatic disconnection.

properties.c_1_description: Pure undiluted Yin energy - the receptive, nurturing power that complements the Creative. Signifies devotion, responsiveness, capacity, motherhood, the earth itself, and the potential to bring things into form and sustain them. Success through adapting, supporting, and following correct initiative.
c_1_line_texts: When there is hoarfrost underfoot, solid ice is not far off.
Straight, square, great. Without purpose, yet nothing remains unfurthered.
Hidden lines. One is able to remain persevering. If by chance you are in the service of a king, seek not works, but bring to completion.
A tied-up sack. No blame, no praise.
A yellow lower garment brings supreme good fortune.
Dragons fight in the meadow. Their blood is black and yellow.
properties.c_3_directional_power: Southwest opening into Southwest - Ultimate maternal receptivity expanding into infinite supportive embrace.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Infinite receptivity mirroring itself in perfect yielding - Earth embracing Earth creates the primordial womb of manifestation. The doubled yin generates a gravitational field of pure receptivity, drawing all potential into form through absolute devotion to the creative impulse. Like fertile soil layered upon fertile soil, this creates inexhaustible capacity for nurturing and sustaining all life through selfless service to the greater unfolding.
properties.c_3_judgment: The Receptive brings about sublime success, furthering through the perseverance of a mare.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Pure yin yielding to itself - the nuclear essence embodies perfect receptivity in infinite openness.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Abdomen/Spleen nurturing Abdomen/Spleen - Pure digestive receptivity where nourishment becomes cosmic service, metabolism achieves perfect efficiency, and foundational strength supports all life. The doubled earth energy creates supreme nurturing capacity and metabolic mastery.

properties.c_1_description: Enthusiasm, movement, and mobilizing energy. Thunder bursts forth from receptive Earth. Following humility, represents time for inspiring action and celebration. Single Yang line leads receptive Yin lines. Foresight needed to ensure enthusiasm is well-directed.
c_1_line_texts: Enthusiasm that expresses itself brings misfortune.
Firm as a rock. Not a whole day. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Enthusiasm that looks upward creates remorse. Hesitation brings remorse.
The source of enthusiasm. He achieves great things. Doubt not.
Persistently ill, and still does not die.
Deluded enthusiasm. But if after completion one changes, there is no blame.
properties.c_3_directional_power: East emergence from Southwest foundation - Initiative arising from receptive support with infectious enthusiasm.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Explosive joy erupts from receptive earth - Thunder's sudden arousal bursts forth from Earth's patient accumulation, creating the ecstatic release of pent-up potential. Movement (Thunder) emerges from stillness (Earth) in triumphant celebration, like seeds exploding into spring growth after winter's patient gestation. This dynamic generates infectious enthusiasm that mobilizes collective energy for great undertakings through shared excitement and common purpose.
properties.c_3_judgment: Enthusiasm. It furthers one to install helpers and to set armies marching.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Pure Receptive nuclear reveals that enthusiasm must be grounded in maternal foundation - joy emerges from nurturing space.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Abdomen/Spleen mobilized by Feet/Liver - Maternal foundation energized by dynamic movement, where digestive stability provides base for liver-driven enthusiasm creating infectious collective energy.

properties.c_1_description: Contemplation, viewing from higher perspective, observing patterns. Wind (gentle influence) moves over Earth (receptive masses), suggesting vantage point for understanding. Looking and being looked at. Understanding through detached observation.
c_1_line_texts: Boy-like contemplation. For an inferior man, no blame. For a superior man, humiliation.
Contemplation through the crack of the door. Furthering for the perseverance of a woman.
Contemplation of my life decides the choice between advance and retreat.
Contemplation of the light of the kingdom.
Contemplation of my life. The superior man is without blame.
Contemplation of his life. The superior man is without blame.
properties.c_3_directional_power: Southeast observation upon Southwest foundation - Gentle influence observing receptive space with penetrating awareness.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Receptive stillness observes subtle influence - Wind's patient penetration moves across Earth's broad expanse, creating the contemplative stance that perceives hidden patterns and subtle changes. Gentle influence (Wind) creates space for deep observation (Earth) to reveal deeper workings through sustained attention. Like wind patterns revealing themselves across a vast plain, this dynamic generates wisdom through receptive awareness and patient observation of natural processes.
properties.c_3_judgment: Contemplation. The ablution has been made, but not yet the offering. Full of trust they look up to him.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Lake over Thunder nuclear reveals that contemplation enables following - observation creates proper responsive relationship.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Abdomen/Spleen observed by Thighs/Hips/Respiratory - Maternal foundation contemplated through gentle breathing, where respiratory awareness studies digestive wisdom creating deep understanding.

properties.c_1_description: Union, alliance, and seeking support. Water (flowing, adapting) flows over Earth (receptive, supportive), like water naturally finding its place on land. Union should arise organically around a worthy central figure. Sincerity and mutual support vital.
c_1_line_texts: Hold to him in truth and loyalty; this is without blame.
Hold to him inwardly. Perseverance brings good fortune.
You hold together with the wrong people.
Hold to him outwardly also. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Manifestation of holding together. The king uses beaters on three sides only and foregoes the game that runs off.
He finds no head for holding together. Misfortune.
properties.c_3_directional_power: North seeking flowing toward Southwest nurturing - Hidden depths finding supportive community through attraction.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Hidden depths seek nurturing ground - Water's seeking nature flows toward Earth's supportive embrace, creating natural affinity and mutual support. The dangerous individual journey (Water) finds safety in collective belonging (Earth), while the community gains vitality from individual contributions. Like streams naturally flowing toward fertile valleys, this generates the organic bonds that unite people through shared purpose and mutual care.
properties.c_3_judgment: Holding Together brings good fortune. Inquire of the oracle once again whether you possess sublimity, constancy, and perseverance.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Thunder over Earth nuclear shows that holding together generates enthusiasm - unity creates infectious joy through shared purpose.
properties.c_3_social_role_dynamics: Mother (earth/nurturing support) embracing Middle Son (water/dangerous journey) - Natural family bonding where maternal care provides foundation for individual depth and dangerous wisdom.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Abdomen/Spleen supporting Kidneys/Ears - Maternal nourishment embracing dangerous depths, where digestive foundation provides safety for survival wisdom and hidden resources.

properties.t_3_seasonal_flow: Winter seeking flowing toward Late Summer nurturing - Individual danger finding safety in collective belonging.

properties.c_1_description: Progress, promotion, and rapid advance like sun rising over earth. Fire ascends above receptive Earth indicating growing influence and recognition. Progress is smooth and unopposed but should be grounded in virtue to be sustainable.
c_1_line_texts: Progressing, but turned back. Perseverance brings good fortune.
Progressing, but in sorrow. Perseverance brings good fortune.
All are in accord. Remorse disappears.
Progress like a hamster. Perseverance brings danger.
Remorse disappears. Take not gain and loss to heart.
Progressing with the horns is permissible only for the purpose of punishing one's own city.
properties.c_3_directional_power: South progress rising from Southwest foundation - Illuminating advancement supported by receptive nurturing space.

properties.c_3_judgment: Progress. The powerful prince is honored with horses in large numbers.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Water over Thunder nuclear reveals that progress navigates initial difficulty - advancement overcomes chaos through persistence.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Abdomen/Spleen illuminated by Eyes/Heart - Maternal foundation supporting cardiovascular brilliance, where digestive wisdom enables heart clarity creating natural advancement and recognition.

properties.c_1_description: Disintegration, erosion, and stripping away. Five Yin lines undermining single Yang line at top - Mountain resting precariously on eroding Earth. Time when inferior forces ascendant. Advice is to adapt, protect essential, and wait for cycle to turn.
c_1_line_texts: The leg of the bed is split. Those who persevere are destroyed. Misfortune.
The bed is split at the edge. Those who persevere are destroyed. Misfortune.
He splits with them. No blame.
The bed is split up to the skin. Misfortune.
A shoal of fishes. Favor comes through the court ladies. Everything acts to further.
There is a large fruit still uneaten. The superior man receives a carriage.
properties.c_3_directional_power: Southwest withdrawal from Northeast nobility - Receptive support failing contemplative dignity through natural entropy.

properties.c_3_judgment: Splitting Apart. It does not further one to go anywhere.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Water over Thunder nuclear reveals that splitting apart contains initial difficulty - dissolution teaches navigation of chaos.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Abdomen/Spleen withdrawing from Back/Hands/Joints - Maternal support eroding beneath contemplative structure, where digestive foundation fails to maintain structural integrity creating dangerous weakness.

properties.c_1_description: Gathering, massing, and collection. Lake above Earth suggests waters collecting in one place. Time for assembly requiring central figure and shared purpose. Preparation needed as gathering creates both opportunity and danger.
c_1_line_texts: If you are sincere, but not to the end, there will sometimes be confusion.
Letting oneself be drawn brings good fortune and remains blameless.
Gathering together amid sighs. Nothing that would further.
Great good fortune. No blame.
If in gathering together one has position, this brings no blame.
Lamenting and sighing, floods of tears. No blame.
properties.c_3_directional_power: West gathering emerging from Southwest foundation - Joyful assembly supported by receptive nurturing space.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Joyful gathering emerges from receptive foundation - Lake's flowing attraction pools upon Earth's supportive ground, creating the magnetic field that naturally assembles community through shared pleasure and common purpose. properties.c_3_judgment: Gathering Together. Success. The king approaches his temple.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Thunder over Earth nuclear shows that gathering generates enthusiasm - community assembly creates infectious joy through unity.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Abdomen/Spleen gathering Mouth/Chest - Maternal foundation attracting joyful expression, where digestive warmth draws together vocal celebration creating natural family gathering.

c_1_line_texts: Innocent behavior brings good fortune.
If one does not count on the harvest while plowing, nor on the use of the ground while clearing it.
Undeserved misfortune. The cow that was tethered by someone is the wanderer's gain, the citizen's loss.
He who can be persevering remains without blame.
Use no medicine in an illness incurred through no fault of your own. It will pass of itself.
Innocent action brings misfortune. Nothing furthers.
properties.c_3_directional_power: Northwest authority harmonizing with East initiative - Divine command supporting natural action through cosmic alignment.

properties.c_1_description: Turning point after extreme decline, return of light and positive energy. Thunder stirs beneath receptive Earth, marking new cycle beginning like Winter Solstice. Natural spontaneous return to goodness. Recognize subtle beginning and nurture gently.
c_1_line_texts: Return from a short distance. No need for remorse. Great good fortune.
Quiet return. Good fortune.
Repeated return. Danger. No blame.
Walking in the midst of others, one returns alone.
Noble-hearted return. No remorse.
Missing the return. Misfortune. Disaster without and within.
properties.c_3_directional_power: Southwest receptivity enabling East return - Maternal space welcoming returning initiative with perfect support.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Returning life stirs within receptive depths - Thunder's vital impulse awakens within Earth's patient embrace, creating the moment when new cycles begin to emerge from apparent endings. Movement (Thunder) returns to receptivity (Earth), while yielding creates the perfect conditions for renewal. Like the first stirrings of spring within winter earth, this dynamic marks the eternal return where endings become beginnings through natural cosmic rhythm.
properties.c_3_judgment: Return. Success. Going out and coming in without error. Friends come without blame. To and fro goes the way.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Mountain over Water nuclear reveals that return requires learning - life force emerges through patient instruction and guidance.
properties.c_3_social_role_dynamics: Mother (earth/patient receptivity) receiving Eldest Son (thunder/returning vitality) - Maternal patience enabling son's return, creating family renewal through welcomed dynamism.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Abdomen/Spleen receiving Feet/Liver - Dynamic life stirring within maternal receptivity, where liver vitality returns to digestive foundation creating natural renewal and rebirth.
properties.t_3_season: Winter Solstice - darkness turns to light
properties.t_3_seasonal_flow: Late Summer receptivity enabling Spring return - Nurturing patience creating ideal conditions for life's return.

c_1_line_texts: Shock comes—oh, oh! Then follow laughing words—ha, ha! Good fortune.
Shock comes bringing danger. A hundred thousand times you lose your treasures.
Shock comes and makes one distraught. If shock spurs to action, one remains free of misfortune.
Shock is mired.
Shock goes hither and thither. Danger. However, nothing at all is lost.
Shock brings ruin and terrified gazing around. Going ahead brings misfortune.
properties.c_3_directional_power: East initiative electrifying East initiative - New beginning energy creating total transformation through pure explosive action.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Shock amplifies into cosmic awakening - Thunder's explosive force doubles upon itself, creating the ultimate arousal that shatters all complacency and demands immediate attention to fundamental reality. Movement upon movement generates the seismic shift that transforms consciousness through the direct encounter with raw life force. Like earthquake followed by aftershock, this dynamic creates the complete disruption necessary for authentic spiritual awakening and the establishment of unshakeable inner equilibrium through conscious relationship with constant change.
properties.c_3_judgment: Shock brings success. Shock comes—oh, oh! Laughing words—ha, ha!
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Mountain over Water nuclear reveals that arousing shock requires learning - explosive awakening guided by patient instruction.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Feet/Liver doubled - Shock upon shock, where liver energy amplifies creating intense arousal requiring grounding, like earthquakes demanding new stability through movement.

c_1_line_texts: It furthers one to accomplish great deeds. Supreme good fortune. No blame.
Someone does indeed increase him. Ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it.
One is enriched through unfortunate events. No blame, if you are sincere.
If you walk in the middle and report to the prince, he will follow.
If in truth you have a kind heart, ask not. Supreme good fortune.
He brings increase to no one. Indeed, someone even strikes him.
properties.c_3_directional_power: East vigor enhancing Southeast gentleness - Initiative supporting gentle influence through sustained beneficial cooperation.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Gentle wisdom enhances vigorous action - Wind's subtle guidance enhances Thunder's powerful movement, creating the benevolent force that brings improvement through harmonious cooperation between adaptability and strength. Yielding (Wind) serves movement (Thunder), generating the perfect combination where gentle influence supports dynamic action. Like favorable winds carrying seeds to fertile ground, this dynamic establishes the flow where individual strength serves collective benefit through conscious contribution.
properties.c_3_judgment: Increase. It furthers one to undertake something. It furthers one to cross the great water.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Heaven over Lake nuclear shows that increase requires proper treading - beneficial expansion maintained through careful conduct.

Like a tender sprout (Thunder) trying to push through resistant soil while navigating a storm (Water). Inherent potential for growth faces immediate obstacles requiring patience and seeking capable helpers.
c_1_line_texts: Hesitation and hindrance. It furthers one to remain persevering. It furthers one to appoint helpers.
Difficulties pile up. Horse and wagon part. He is not a robber; he wants to woo when the time comes.
Whoever hunts deer without the forester only loses his way in the forest.
Horse and wagon part. Strive for union. To go brings good fortune.
Difficulties in blessing. A little perseverance brings good fortune. Great perseverance brings misfortune.
Horse and wagon part. Bloody tears flow.
properties.c_3_directional_power: North mystery confronting East initiative - Hidden depths testing new beginnings with dangerous but necessary trials.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Primordial chaos births movement - dangerous Water hovers over explosive Thunder, creating the turbulent conditions of new beginnings. Thunder's upward surge meets Water's downward flow in perpetual tension, like lightning trapped beneath storm clouds. This dynamic generates the friction necessary for manifestation, where raw potential struggles against resistance to achieve initial form through determined persistence against overwhelming odds.
properties.c_3_judgment: Difficulty at the Beginning works supreme success, furthering through perseverance. Nothing should be undertaken. It furthers one to appoint helpers.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Fire over Water nuclear reveals that initial difficulty contains incompletion - chaos teaches patient navigation toward future clarity.

properties.c_1_description: Forcefully removing obstruction, like biting through something stuck between teeth. Need for decisive action in administering justice. Clarity (Fire) combines with energetic movement (Thunder) to cut through difficulties. Requires firmness and fairness.
c_1_line_texts: His feet are fastened in the stocks, so that his toes disappear. No blame.
Bites through tender meat, so that his nose disappears. No blame.
Bites on old dried meat and strikes on something poisonous.
Bites on dried gristly meat. Receives metal arrows.
Bites on dried lean meat. Receives yellow gold. Perseveringly aware of danger. No blame.
His neck is fastened in the wooden cangue, so that his ears disappear. Misfortune.
properties.c_3_directional_power: South clarity directing East action - Illuminating awareness guiding decisive initiative with perfect justice.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Explosive force illuminates decisive action - Fire's revealing light crowns Thunder's sudden movement, creating the perfect conditions for cutting through obstacles and resolving conflicts. Clarity (Fire) guides movement (Thunder) to generate the decisive force needed to break through deception and establish justice. Like lightning revealing and destroying in the same instant, this dynamic combines illumination with transformative power to restore proper order.
properties.c_3_judgment: Biting Through has success. It is favorable to let justice be administered.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Wind over Lake nuclear reveals that biting through requires inner truth - decisive justice guided by authentic sincerity.

properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Feet/Liver illuminated by Eyes/Heart - Dynamic action clarified by cardiovascular vision, where heart-centered clarity guides liver-driven movement creating decisive breakthrough.
properties.t_3_seasonal_flow: Summer clarity directing Spring action - Brilliant insight guiding dynamic movement toward just resolution.

properties.c_1_description: Nourishment both physical and spiritual. Image of open mouth with firm jaws above and below. Mountain stillness above Thunder movement below suggests balance of rest and action. Mindfulness of consumption and production of words and actions.
c_1_line_texts: You let your magic tortoise go, and look at me with the corners of your mouth drooping. Misfortune.
Turning to the summit for nourishment, deviating from the path.
Turning away from nourishment. Perseverance brings misfortune.
Turning to the summit for provision of nourishment brings good fortune.
Turning away from the path. To remain persevering brings good fortune.
The source of nourishment. Awareness of danger brings good fortune.
properties.c_3_directional_power: Northeast stillness grounding East movement - Contemplative boundaries providing foundation for nourishing initiative.
properties.c_3_image_dynamics: Nourishing stillness contains vital movement - Mountain's stable presence above Thunder's vital energy creates the structure of proper nourishment. Stillness (Mountain) provides the container for movement (Thunder), like jaws that must remain firm to enable the action of eating. This dynamic establishes the rhythm where rest and action serve the greater purpose of sustaining life through mindful consumption and expression.
properties.c_3_judgment: The Corners of the Mouth. Perseverance brings good fortune. Pay heed to the providing of nourishment and to what a man seeks to fill his own mouth with.
properties.c_3_nuclear_dynamics: Wind over Lake nuclear shows that nourishment requires inner truth - proper care provided through authentic sincerity.
properties.l_3_body_dynamics: Feet/Liver stabilized by Back/Hands/Joints - Dynamic movement grounded by contemplative structure, where stillness above and movement below create proper nourishment rhythm like jaws chewing.

c_1_line_texts: The standard is changing. Perseverance brings good fortune.
If one clings to the little boy, one loses the strong man.
If one clings to the strong man, one loses the little boy.
Following creates success. Perseverance brings misfortune.
Sincere in the good. Good fortune.
He meets with firm allegiance and is still further bound.
properties.c_3_directional_power: West pleasure following East initiative - Joyful adaptation creating natural order through wise response.

properties.c_1_description: Xun embodies gentle but persistent influence, like wind shaping landscapes over time or roots penetrating soil. It represents subtle power, adaptability, and the ability to influence through persistence rather than force.

properties.c_1_description: Unexpected encounter, temptation, and subtle infiltration. Wind beneath Heaven suggests hidden influence creeping in. Single Yin line at bottom threatens to undermine Yang above. Caution against seductive or corrupting influences.
c_1_line_texts: It must be checked with a brake of bronze. Perseverance brings good fortune.
There is a fish in the tank. No blame. Does not further guests.
There is no skin on his thighs, and walking comes hard.
No fish in the tank. This leads to misfortune.
A melon covered with willow leaves. Hidden lines. Then it drops down from heaven.
He comes to meet with his horns. Humiliation. No blame.
properties.c_3_directional_power: Southeast temptation penetrating Northwest order - Subtle influence threatening divine command through harmless seduction.

properties.q_0_nucleotide_charge_ground: M3-2's ground is the four-letter substrate beneath all combination — the nucleotides themselves, each a charged elemental primitive before any codon assembles them. Adenine the primary Yang (purine, double-ring, 2 hydrogen bonds, integrals pp 84 / nn −36) and Thymine the primary Yin (pyrimidine, single-ring, pp 96 / nn −24) stand as the Taoist poles — white-active-expanding against black-passive-contracting, Pingala against Ida, Fire against Water. Manifesting #2 within Mahāmāya, its ground is the 64-hexagram alphabet M3-1 handed down, now grounded in chemistry: the 2-bit encoding A=00, T=01, C=10, G=11 by which each base IS two binary features (`Z₄ ≅ Z₂ × Z₂`, purine/pyrimidine × amino/keto). Before there is a codon there are four letters with charge — the alphabet life rests its whole act of self-writing upon.
properties.q_1_sixty_four_codon_alphabet: What M3-2 IS: the complete 64-fold genetic code — "the complete genetic architecture from individual nucleotides through base pairs to the full 64-codon system, the fundamental language through which life writes itself into existence." Its substance is the atomic unit at three scales: 4 nucleotides, 16 dinucleotide base-pairs, 64 codons — each codon a 6-bit word built `outer<<4 | middle<<2 | inner` from three 2-bit letters. This is #2 as Entity within the symbolic domain: not the law of change (M3-1) but the discrete biological things that change acts upon, the foundational layer containing every nucleotide, pair, and codon that encodes biological information. The same 2⁶ = 64 space the I-Ching read as situations, DNA reads as the actual molecules of inheritance. Each codon is an atom of meaning-bearing matter: Codon_AAA the "Pure Yang Trinity" coding Lysine, a perfect palindrome with definite inner charges. The alphabet is the matter; the matter is the alphabet.
properties.q_3_four_class_codon_typology: Structurally M3-2 is the four-tier codon typology — the algorithmic classifier that sorts all 64 codons by their symmetry: 4 perfect palindromes (n1=n2=n3, the AAA/TTT/CCC/GGG cardinals), 12 imperfect palindromes (n1=n3≠n2), 24 non-palindromic non-dual (one repeated adjacent pair), and 24 fully dual (all neighbours differ). This yields the load-bearing partition 40 non-dual + 24 dual = 64, and the rotational law 40×7 + 24×8 = 472 distinct states (compile-asserted in `m3.h`). The pattern is symmetry-as-structure: a non-dual codon has an axis and collapses 8 raw rotations to 7; a dual codon preserves all 8. As an explicate derived ratio (Cl(4,2) signature +1) it is the which of matter — the lawful, transmissible classification that holds the genetic alphabet as a navigable, typed space. The four perfect palindromes stand as cardinal directions in genetic space; the structure is a mandala of unity and tension.
properties.q_4_language_life_writes_itself: M3-2's telos is to be the language in which life writes itself — the for-the-sake-of-incarnation: a symbolic alphabet that is simultaneously the actual chemistry of inheritance, so that the abstract 64-space has a body. Its why is to supply the Mahāmāya trinity's material pole: where the I-Ching gives change and Tarot gives manifestation, DNA gives the substance both operate on — the codons that will be transcribed (M3-3), reflected as cards (M3-4), and arrayed on the wheel (M3-5). The quaternion-elemental signature fixes its purpose at the root: position 1 = real = A = Material cause = Earth = Sensation; i = U = Efficient = Water = Feeling; j = G = Formal = Air = Thinking; k = C = Context = Fire = Intuition. The genetic code exists so that the four causes have a molecular alphabet — so that meaning can be written into existence one codon at a time, and read back out as life.
properties.q_5_codon_handed_to_transcription: M3-2's synthesis is the alphabet completing itself by passing into act — the static 64-codon archive handed to M3-3's Universal Transcription Engine, where the eternal DNA archive becomes active RNA messenger through the T→U gateway. The entity closes by becoming process: the codon that merely IS becomes the codon that is read, transcribed, translated into amino acid, folded into protein. Read as position-2, the live combinatorial act settles into the pattern that will carry it — the 64 letters becoming the sacred pathway Archive→Message→Form→Vessel. The 37 T-containing codons already carry their RNA-potential forward; the 4 perfect palindromes already anchor the wheel's cardinal directions. What M3-2 holds as the alphabet of life, M3-3 re-takes as the transcription of life: the noun of matter re-opened into the verb of meaning. The letters hand themselves on to be spoken.

properties.q_0_convergence_ground: M3-5's ground is everything that came before it — the manifested cards of M3-4, the transcribed pathway of M3-3, the codon-alphabet of M3-2, the change-grammar of M3-1, the received vibration of M3-0 — all resting now as the relational threads about to be woven. Manifesting #5 within Mahāmāya, its ground is the completed-but-uncollapsed: 360° of finite-yet-exhaustive positional meaning standing ready, every position already holding its 720° shadow. Its deeper void-pole is the central hub itself — the Axis Mundi (#3-5-5/0), "the hole in the toroidal structure," the still-point where all motion ceases yet contains all motion. M3-5 is twin to M3-0: where M3-0 received, M3-5 returns; the same emptiness read once as zero-degree origin and once as quintessential totality. The ground of synthesis is the source-void from which Heaven, Earth, Thunder, Lake, Water, Fire, Wind, Mountain emerge — the wheel's empty centre, on which the whole turning rests.
properties.q_1_anima_mundi_rotunda: What M3-5 IS: the 360° Mythic Synthesis Wheel — the Anima Mundi Rotunda (⊚), the living mandala, the crown achievement of Mahāmāya's transcription engine. Its substance is the universal convergence point of all relational threads: genetic matrices, hexagram transformations, tarot rotations, and archetypal mathematics woven into coherent mythic narrative. This is #5 as Integration within the symbolic domain — not the manifestation-engine (M3-4) but the *synthesis of everything*, 365 nodes forming the complete archetypal calendar: four compass anchors (N/S/E/W bound to the perfect-palindrome codons GGG/AAA/CCC at the cardinals), the Central Unity Point, 360 degree-positions, 16 division lenses, 9 transformational chambers, 22 Major Arcana pathways. Where consciousness encounters its own infinite creativity through finite-but-complete archetypal positioning. The wheel is the matheme's own clock made seeable: every query becomes a mythopoeic event where eternal patterns reveal themselves through specific moments of meaning.
properties.q_2_double_covering_act: M3-5 operates by folding — the 720° double-covering quaternionic superposition that ensures "every light position contains its shadow integration." Its how is the spinor return: a full identity requires not 360° but 720°, two Pisano periods, 120 Fibonacci steps, so the wheel is traversed twice — once as explicit Strand A (φ ascending), once as implicit Strand B — before the trajectory closes. The relating it operates is mythic convergence: all threads weave into narrative, past/present/future collapse into the mythic present (temporal binding), personal story connects to cosmic drama (dimensional bridge). The 16 lenses act as the operation of reading — each a division-grammar of the circle, from 1°×360 unity to 360°×1 multiplicity, the complete harmonic series of consciousness fragmentation. To synthesise is to fold the many back into one: archetypal patterns recognised through 16-lens viewing, every position turning through its light/shadow superposition until the wheel knows itself whole.
properties.q_3_mandala_lens_chamber_structure: Structurally M3-5 is the cosmic mandala — a 365-node archetypal calendar of exact composition. Nine enneadic chambers of 40° each tile the 360° (9×40 = 360, the enneadic lens), each chamber a complete cycle of transformational initiation. Sixteen division lenses array the harmonic series of fragmentation (the 16 clean divisors-grammars of 360, reciprocal-complementary pairs exhausting the circle from opposite resolutions). Twenty-two Major Arcana pathways run as privileged transformation corridors — highways through the archetypal landscape, the 22 autosomes made into routes. The 720° architecture doubles every position into light/shadow. As the #5 Integration-pole (Cl(4,2) implicate, signature −1) it is structure that completes and re-opens: the central Unity Point (#3-5-5/0) is at once the quintessential totality and the zero-degree origin, the +1 that makes 360 into the complete calendar and the Fibonacci-Pisano growth aperture by which the wheel can spiral to a new octave. The shape is a torus seen from its empty hole — finite, exhaustive, and endlessly re-enterable.
properties.q_4_mythopoeic_yearning_why: M3-5's telos is mythopoeic synthesis — the why that turns archetypal mathematics into lived narrative: the wheel exists so that "static possibilities become living relationships," so that the whole symbolic engine resolves into a story a consciousness can recognise itself in. Its deepest purpose is Sacred Incompleteness — "the 64-fold yearning that drives eternal transformation": the wheel is complete enough to hold all meaning yet incomplete enough to keep turning, the finite 360° forever short of the infinite it points to. As the #5 position its why is the to-where, the integrated insight toward which the whole 0-4 circulation has moved: the meta-synthesis interface that receives the processed outputs of M3-0 through M3-4 and delivers integrated mythic narrative onward. It exists to be the gateway — the transcendent function by which Mahāmāya's symbolic totality passes through complete integration toward #5 Epii, and the living mythology Nara (M4) will render dialogically. The wheel exists so that meaning becomes myth, and myth becomes the language a life can be read in.
properties.q_5_mobius_return_to_ground: M3-5's synthesis is the Möbius return itself — the 5→0 fold where the completed wheel re-opens as new ground. Its centre IS the seam: the Axis Mundi (#3-5-5/0) is dual-natured, Quintessential-Unity AND Zero-Degree, and its first child the Alpha-Omega Point — "the threshold where ending becomes beginning," Ultimate-Yin-turning-Yang. After 720° (two full Pisano periods, the spinor's complete identity restoration) the trajectory closes and the wheel blooms whole, then the centre pulses one bright pulse and the cycle restarts — the still-point that contains all motion handing the whole synthesis back to M3-0's receptive intake as tomorrow's tuning. Read as position-5, M3-5 completes Mahāmāya only by re-opening it: the universal transcription it totalises sediments into the personal oracle M4 will cast, and the symbolic language a life can be read in becomes the ground the next reading rises from. The wheel turns; the matheme returns; the last degree is the first reception renamed, and Mahāmāya begins again.
